It leaves $0.94B for external Foundry and external All Other, whereas our modeled All Other proxy is $2.8B and gross packaging is $0.5B. This is a headroom diagnostic showing the optimistic direction of our forecast. It is not a fully matched revenue beat: legacy external Foundry and future Other eliminations are unspecified.
